sections.heading: Dashboard
added: A promotional code is entered on the Stripe checkout screen.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Billing shows how many free asks are left and upgrades this computer to idk Pro.

sections.heading: Overlay
added: The first 5 asks are free. After that, Upgrade opens Billing.
fixes: An ask still answers when the screenshot model is unavailable.

updates.title: The ask bar is a smooth capsule

sections.heading: Overlay
fixes: The ask bar is a smooth capsule, with sharp text and rounded ends.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Settings sells idk Pro for $3 a month, and asking stays on while that subscription is active.

sections.heading: Site
added: The site lists idk Pro at $3 a month.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Sidebar, buttons, switches, rows, and cards light up and press in when you hover or click.
Settings lets the search bar follow the cursor, or locks the mini search bar at the bottom center of the screen.
How to use includes a short paragraph you can highlight to try the ask bar.
Settings can keep idk off screenshots, screen shares, and streams.

sections.heading: Overlay
fixes: Selecting text in an editor or browser opens the ask bar, and the bar stays up after it takes focus.
Shift + select opens the ask bar when Shift was held during the drag.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Settings no longer asks for an API key. Model access is built into idk.
fixes: Dashboard buttons and chat rows open again. A font helper was stopping the click.

sections.heading: Chat
added: Questions use the sealed model key. That key is not saved in settings and is not shown on screen.

sections.heading: Setup
added: idk installs from a Windows setup file and shows the license before setup finishes.
A license is $5.99 once for this computer. Copying the app or the license file does not unlock another computer.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: Settings can buy a license for this computer and shows when this computer is already paid.

sections.heading: Chat
added: Asking waits until this computer is licensed.
